decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the any wall or roof slope of the extensions hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the inaccurate  side elevation (proposed side elevation 1) shown on drawing HUSSAIN/01, the single-storey rear extension hereby approved shall be no greater than 3.6m depth when taken from the main rear building line of the house at the point next to the side boundary with number 6 Vicarage Farm Road as shown on drawing number HUSSAIN/02.

Condition : 6 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the proposed extensions because of their sympathetic scale, appearance and relative position to adjoining properties, would be compatible with the character and appearance of the property and the street scene, and would not harm neighbours' living conditions. Furthermore the proposal would comply with the Council's parking standards. The proposal would therefore accord with adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), T.1.4 (Car and Cycling Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Demolition of existing garage and erection of part two-storey, part single-storey side extension and single-storey rear extension to house.
